text:
sasha: Heads-up — onboarding example app breaks in our edge ESM build. Types fail when consumers import `RedwoodClient` from the CJS shim. Behavior: runtime works, but TS inference collapses to `any` for generic return types.

marco: ugh. is this the `module`/`moduleResolution` tsconfig mismatch? node16 vs bundler?

sasha: I tried `module: "esnext", moduleResolution: "bundler"` and also `node16`. Same issue. Specifically overload selection uses `any` in the merged d.ts. Repro repo: https://git.internal/repro/edge-esm-any-unknown (private)

emily: can you paste the minimal overload that's failing? may be an `unknown` narrowing edge-case with conditional types.

sasha: sure — simplified:

```ts
// from @redwood/sdk
export function call<T>(route: string, opts?: CallOpts): Promise<T>
export function call(route: string, opts?: CallOpts): Promise<any>
```

In consumers with `esModuleInterop: false` and `moduleResolution: bundler` the compiler prefers the second signature and infers `any` for `T`.

marco: that looks like overload ordering + emit difference between ESM dts and CJS dts. We saw this with our edge runner where `export =` + `default` shims reorder things. Might need to rework to a single generic signature with a discriminated option instead of two overloads.

kevin: +1 on single signature. Also, the auth/retry wrapper we inject at build-time swaps the exported function to a wrapped `const call = createCall(auth, retry)` which loses the original overloads in the .d.ts unless we use `declare function` + `export { call }`. The bundle transform is likely turning it into `const call: any` in the emitted declaration file.

emily: quick mitigation: publish a `dist/esm/types.d.ts` that preserves `declare function call<T>(...)` before bundling. We can also add a test that compiles the sample app with `tsc --noEmit` using `moduleResolution: bundler` and `node16` matrix.

sasha: agreed. For short-term docs: add a note in onboarding that if you target edge+bundler, set `skipLibCheck: true` is not a fix, it's a footgun. Instead add example tsconfig and a link to the repro.

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-8421 to track: "edge ESM d.ts overloads -> any inference" — assignee: @marco — priority: P2 :thumbsup:

marco: I'll take INF-8421. Plan: (1) try `declare function` + re-export, (2) add CI compile check, (3) publish patched types build. Anyone want to pair on step 1?

emily: I can help for an hour this afternoon.

sasha: thanks — will drop the tiny repro and a failing tsc invocation into the ticket.
